applies_why: The judge weighs the challenger's own seed/loins chain against the defender's chain on link D6 vs C1, which is the chain-against-chain collision the rule governs.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter
rule_words: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; Whether a single verse, or the chain read together, states a link in so many words is never the deciding test, for or against.
room: The phrase 'does not name Joseph as the begetter': I weighed reading it as a neutral note of footing against reading it as a stating-in-words test applied to the pressing side's chain.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED result leans on whether the challenger's chain names Joseph in words, which is the stating test the rule retires.
